name: Desk by Ouroboros Apps
description: Desk by Ouroboros Apps (https://ouroborosapps.com). Customer support policy for assistants: approved support answers, refund rules, and escalation limits read before replying; unapproved promises go to human review. Tools: list_support_desks, create_support_desk, save_approved_answer, search_approved_answers, save_refund_rule, list_refund_rules, save_escalation_limit, list_escalation_limits, save_approved_commitment, list_approved_commitments, evaluate_commitment, evaluate_escalation, get_desk_context. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth and Dynamic Client Registration; requires an account. Docs: https://ouroborosapps.com/docs/desk. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.LAHutchins91/desk.
